name: Slovakia

income_tax.summary: 2026 scale: 19% on the tax base up to EUR 43,983.32 (154.8x the subsistence minimum), 25% to EUR 60,349.21, 30% to EUR 75,010.32, 35% above. Non-taxable amount EUR 5,966.73 a year, full up to a tax base of EUR 26,367.26 and zero from EUR 50,234.18. Employee contributions: 9.4% social (maximum monthly assessment base EUR 16,764, i.e. EUR 201,168 a year) and 5% health (no cap); the recorded rate is the combined 14.4% and the cap applies to the social part only.
income_tax.self_employed_notes: Self-employed contributions 2026: social 33.15% (sickness 4.40, old-age 18, disability 6, solidarity reserve 4.75) on a base of about one twelfth of the business tax base times 1.486, minimum EUR 914.40 a month (minimum payment EUR 303.11), maximum EUR 16,764 a month; health 16% on a base of at least EUR 762 (minimum EUR 121.92 a month), no maximum. The recorded 49.15% is the statutory sum on the assessment base, not an effective rate on gross income. Business income: a 15% rate applies to self-employed income up to EUR 100,000 (Forvis Mazars); option of 60% lump-sum expenses up to EUR 20,000 a year for non-VAT-payers (PwC).
income_tax.local_tax_note: No local income tax in the sources opened.

regimes.name: Flat-rate expenses for self-employed (60%, max EUR 20,000)
regimes.description: Self-employed people who are not Slovak VAT payers and do not have only rental income may deduct 60% of income as lump-sum expenses up to EUR 20,000 a year instead of actual costs.

regimes.name: 15% rate on self-employed income up to EUR 100,000
regimes.description: A 15% income tax rate applies to natural persons earning entrepreneurial income, per the Forvis Mazars 2026 CEE guide, with an annual cap of EUR 100,000.
regimes.duration_note: Open-ended while income stays below the cap.
open_questions: Exact conditions (turnover vs profit) not opened.

rent_1bed_monthly.description: Average rent for a Slovak '2-room' flat (one bedroom plus living room), Bencont Investments 1Q 2026 average (EUR 908) as quoted by Investropa, updated 5 Oct 2026; Investropa states about EUR 900-925, range 800-1,050.

costs.notes: Bencont figures as reported by a secondary site; Deloitte Rent Index Q2 2026 reports Bratislava all-flat average EUR 931 (search snippet, not opened).

residence_routes: EU citizens can live and work freely. Non-EU nationals need a temporary residence permit for employment (with a job offer) or for business; no remote-worker visa was found and no official page was opened, so the details are unverified.
